subject: economics
objective: What is GDP by the expenditure approach?
instruction: Harbourview reports for the year: household consumption USD 3,200,000, gross investment USD 800,000, government spending USD 1,100,000, exports USD 600,000, imports USD 700,000, net factor income from abroad USD 90,000, depreciation USD 250,000 and a population of 2,000 people. The statistical office has not published a GDP deflator or any price index for the year. Use the expenditure method for GDP, gross national income (GNI) = GDP + net factor income from abroad, net national income (NNI) = GNI - depreciation, and real GDP = nominal GDP / GDP deflator x 100 (base year = 100). Per-person figures divide by the population. Express the answer as real GDP and real GDP per person. Required: real gdp, real gdp per capita.
